title: Duplexer Module - Band 5 (850 MHz) for Public Safety Band Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Raj Patel

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Duplexer Module filter targeting Band 5 (850 MHz) for Public Safety Band Filter. The filter is designed on AlN on SiC substrate with a target center frequency of 2070.2 MHz and bandwidth of 269.3 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Public Safety Band Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Duplexer Module
- Frequency Band: Band 5 (850 MHz)
- Application: Public Safety Band Filter
- Substrate: AlN on SiC
- Package: LGA (Land Grid Array)
- Design Tool: CST Studio Suite 2024
- Design Center: Irvine Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the Duplexer Module design targeting Band 5 (850 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       2070.2 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       269.3 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.2 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 8.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 23.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 32.0 dB
Q Factor:               13579
Temperature Coefficient:-23.0 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.5 x 0.6 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   11
Electrode Material:     Mo
Passivation:            SiO2/Si3N4 stack
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open CST Studio Suite 2024 and load the Duplexer Module template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: AlN on SiC with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 2070.2 MHz, BW 269.3 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.2 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (LGA (Land Grid Array)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, AlN on SiC).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight E5080B ENA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 6211 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.2 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 8.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 404 MHz offset >= 23.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 9 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 6.0 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +34 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 2000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 96%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-06-05
Devices Tested:         33
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.9 dB
Return Loss (meas):     10.5 dB
Rejection (meas):       25.6 dB
Isolation (meas):       36.7 dB
Q Factor (meas):        13579
Group Delay Variation:  4.3 ns
Power Handling:         +33 dBm
Die Yield:              90.6%

Result Classification:  CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Duplexer Module design demonstrated acceptable performance for Band 5 (850 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Rejection at near-band offset requires additional resonator tuning.
d) Package parasitic effects were consistent with 3D EM model predictions.
e) No delamination observed after 1000-cycle thermal shock test.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
